sodium oxide + carbon → sodium + carbon dioxide
A
sodium oxide + iron → sodium + iron(II) oxide
B
iron(II) oxide + copper → iron + copper(II) oxide
C
iron(III) oxide + carbon → iron + carbon dioxide
D
